600	A book, Emek HaMelech, writes about Rabbi Moshe Vital: he was a great chasid, and Elijah the Prophet, of blessed memory,	Escreve sobre Rabi Moshe Vital: era um grande chassid, e Eliyahu, o Profeta, de abençoada memória,
